issues.description: The UML/problem statement declares Ride with an attribute 'abbreviation: char' and therefore students will expect a corresponding getter (e.g., getAbbreviation()). The solution implementation defines the attribute as 'shortName' with a getter getShortName(), changing the attribute name and getter name compared to the specification. This naming mismatch between the specification and the solution can confuse students about the expected attribute/getter names and may cause tests that check for the UML-named attribute/getter to fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the implementation with the UML/specification: rename the Ride attribute 'shortName' to 'abbreviation' (char) and provide a getter named getAbbreviation(). Ensure constructor parameter names and any subclasses' super(...) calls use the 'abbreviation' parameter name to match the UML naming, or alternatively update the problem statement/tests to accept getShortName().
